subject: Inline method invocation
notes: kb/Work PB1142 landed (w65c). cite.py --check 8.4.3.4.3 'Inline method invocation shall not be specified as a receiving operand.' OK. Holds STRUCTURALLY for every purely receiving rule (InlineMethodInvocationOperandDriftTests), and by the bind-time Format-1 screen for the two MIXED-ROLE arithmetic rules (receiversOrSendingOperand, the TO / FROM / INTO operand of ADD, SUBTRACT and DIVIDE, and multiplyByOperand, MULTIPLY's BY operand): ADD/SUBTRACT/MULTIPLY/DIVIDE ... TO/FROM/BY/INTO OB::"M" without GIVING are each COBOL1689 naming SR1 - before, ADD/SUBTRACT/MULTIPLY compiled clean with the receiver dropped and DIVIDE crashed the compiler (InvalidOperationException in ArithmeticEmitter.EmitDivide). MOVE ... TO and INSPECT receivers are refused by the grammar / COBOL1632 as before. The rule's subject is a 2002 construct (8.4.3.4, introduced by COBOL 2002), so the editions are 2002+.
